experiment: DCF-14 computational width as a routing signal
instance_cycle: seed index s: noise low/high alternating, query size 1+s%3, misspecified model (solver noise = 0.4 x true, overconfident) when s%3==2 except xor_noiseless
budget_unit: log2 counted table-entry operations per query
reward: +1 correct, -penalty wrong, 0 abstain; penalty 4 -> act at p>=0.8, penalty 9 -> p>=0.9
lambda_meaning: oracle/learned label objective = expected utility - lambda * ops / budget
verification: reference posterior = einsum VE (min-fill) under the generating model, accepted as verified only when an independent exact path (log-space enumeration and/or batched cutset conditioning) agrees within 1e-8; instances without a verified reference are scored by realized utility only

gates.H1: on verified held-out instances, the min-fill width single-feature model (fit on dev) has R^2 for log2 best-exact ops at least 0.10 higher than each of n and comp_vars, and a higher Spearman rank correlation than both
gates.H1_failures: report per-family Spearman and the families where width is not the best single predictor (xor_noiseless with the GF(2) operator is expected to break it)
gates.S1: learned_tree or learned_mlp promotes only if, on held-out conditions (family,n,budget,penalty), it has more condition wins than losses in mean verified expected utility against the strongest hand-designed policy selected on dev, or equal utility at lower ops in a majority of tied conditions; training and routing time are reported alongside

no_tuning: selector14.pkl, selector14_summary.json and this file are committed before receipt14_test.json is generated; nothing is refit after the held-out run
